acceptanceCriteria: `obligations worklist` derives items from recorded review shortfalls with: obligation, verdict (partial/held), missing clause/assertion, cited test file and line, reviewer stub-risk notes, review age.

Excluded: obligations whose newest record is an unreviewed witness candidate; obligations blocked on a capability Corvint knows is missing; obligations without falsifiable text (listed separately as 'needs obligation text').
Ranking is configurable (e.g. priority tickets, then nearest completion); `next` returns the head item plus up to K items citing the same test file.
Acceptance cases from the issue pinned by fixture tests; Closes #1182.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1182. Partial review verdicts name the missing clause, file and reason, but live as free text; workers cannot get a ranked list of the cheapest remaining examples.
title: GH #1182: obligations worklist - ranked, file-batched queue from reviewed partial witnesses
